item.title: Kylie Minogue Confirms 40th Anniversary Tour Plans: ‘I’m Probably Not Meant to Say This, But Yes’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about a pop icon who's been making waves for decades: Kylie Minogue.
[Short music transition]
Host: In a recent interview with The Sunday Times' Style magazine, Kylie Minogue accidentally let slip that she's planning a tour to celebrate her 40th anniversary in music. The tour is set to take place in 2027, marking four decades since she launched her pop career with a cover of "The Loco-Motion" in 1987.
[Short music transition]
Host: This news comes just ahead of the premiere of her Netflix documentary series, KYLIE, which drops on May 20. The three-part series features insights from Dannii Minogue, Jason Donovan, and Nick Cave, and covers Kylie's journey, including her breast cancer diagnosis and personal struggles.
[Short music transition]
Host: Kylie expressed her excitement and nerves about the documentary, saying it was a challenge to tell her story. She also revealed that writing an original song for the documentary's closing sequence was an emotional experience.
[Short music transition]
Host: When she's not working on her own music, Kylie's been listening to rising artists like Sombr, Wolf Alice, and Coldplay. And, she's expressed her desire to return to acting, possibly even doing a musical.
[Short music transition]
Host: With over 80 million records sold worldwide, Kylie Minogue is a true music legend. From her debut album in 1988 to her recent viral hit "Padam Padam" in 2023, she's been making music that's endured for decades.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in. Don't forget to check out Kylie's documentary series on Netflix, premiering May 20. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon.
